unresolved_items.reason: The cited tangent-angle paper requires an identified stable stage, while the specified thesis does not give an Ootang-reproducible start/end rule for the selected initial displacement.
The source writes V approximately equal to V0 but gives no numeric tolerance or boundary ownership.
The specified thesis table writes 5V0<=alpha<10V0 in a rate table; this is dimensionally inconsistent and must not be silently corrected.
The source supports negative/near-zero/positive trend states but supplies no Ootang numeric near-zero tolerance.
Quantile-order, coverage, symmetry, tail-diagnostic and fallback thresholds must be fixed before a normal-distribution-style five-level interval mapping is used.
The specified thesis uses supervised multinomial logistic regression; the approved non-supervised replacement still needs a transparent rule table F.
The approved multi-station output requires a traceable F_site and contribution-station rule.
The original tangent-angle paper recommends equal-interval monitoring before angle calculation; the current Ootang data are daily, but a missing/nonregular-data rule is still needed.
